title: FGE - Frame Engine
tagline: Create engaging Farcaster Frames with FGE developed by TOCD. It is a no-code tool leveraging Google Sheets for easy customization and sharing. Perfect for anyone looking to share creative content on Warpcast.
description:
FGE (Frame Generator Engine) is a tool of the Farcaster Community that offers its users the possibility of creating and customizing Frames with no-code. It all works from a simple Google Spreadsheet, wherein you input the content you want, upload an image, and off sharing your creations on Warpcast. TOCD (The Old Castle Defense) is pledged to give its complete support and assures you that all the framework created by it provides the best experience, which you would be sure to experience. Creating the most beautiful and entirely personalized frames has never been easier in Farcaster.

how_its_made: TOCD Studio developed FGE on Python using gspread lib to sync data from the Google Sheets. TOCD worked with Pinata SDK and Analytics, The Graph (Deployment & Playground & Integration), Base Node RPCs, Optimism, Debridge, 1inch Protocol. We developed Pinata & TheGraph Python Framework for easy integration to any frames.
